danza_kuduro.wav  (default; NOT redistributable, untracked by git)
  "Danza Kuduro" - Don Omar ft. Lucenzo. Commercially released, all rights reserved.
  Converted locally from the user's own copy in ~/Downloads for personal/bench use.
  Do not commit, redistribute or ship this file with the package. If you clone this
  repo elsewhere the file will be absent -- pass sound_file:=<your own copy> or fall
  back to one of the freely licensed clips below.

Sounds bundled with primitive_camera_tools.

perreo.wav   (default)
  Title  : Perreo Wiki
  Author : ProtoplasmaKid
  Source : https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Perreo_Wiki.wav
  License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
           https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
  Unmodified copy downloaded from Wikimedia Commons.
  NOTE: CC BY-SA requires attribution AND that derivative works of the audio be
        shared under the same licence. Using it as an alert sound in this package
        does not make the software a derivative work, but redistributing the audio
        (modified or not) requires keeping this notice.

emergency.wav
  Title  : Sad Trombone
  Author : Sad Tromboner
  Source : https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sad_Trombone.wav
  License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
           https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  Unmodified copy downloaded from Wikimedia Commons.

To use your own audio instead, pass sound_file:=/path/to/file.wav to the launch.
paplay/aplay handle WAV, OGG and FLAC; for MP3 either pass player:=ffplay or
convert first:  ffmpeg -i song.mp3 song.wav
